subtitulo: Five questions about the flat line, the tease and the joke that is yours
introPt: A long table, a tease that sounds harder than it is, and a visitor working out who is allowed to say what.
cenario: Late in a meal, with people who have known each other for twenty years and one guest who has not.

dialogo.es: Σιγά τα λάχανα! Πρώτη φορά το ακούω.
dialogo.pt: Big deal! First I've heard of it.
dialogo.tts: Σιγά τα λάχανα! Πρώτη φορά το ακούω.

dialogo.pt: Right, seriously? You're winding me up!

dialogo.es: Τα ελληνικά μου είναι τραγικά, το ξέρω!
dialogo.pt: My Greek is tragic, I know!
dialogo.tts: Τα ελληνικά μου είναι τραγικά, το ξέρω!

perguntas.pergunta: Σιγά is said perfectly flat. What does it mean there?
opcoes: Slow down, please
Big deal — the opposite of impressed
Careful
Wait for me
perguntas.explica: Σιγά literally means slowly, and σιγά τα λάχανα is literally slow the cabbages. Said level, both mean big deal. The flatness is the whole signal.

perguntas.pergunta: Πλάκα κάνω has just landed. What has happened?
opcoes: An apology was offered
A price was quoted
The tease was closed — that was a joke
Somebody left the table
perguntas.explica: It is the standard closer, and it arrives fast, before the sharpness can settle wrong.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone says με δουλεύεις. What is going on?
opcoes: You are being asked about your job
You are being accused, friendlily, of winding them up
You are being asked to work
You are being told off
perguntas.explica: Δουλεύω is to work, and to work somebody is to pull their leg. Saying it back is itself a way of joining in.

perguntas.pergunta: The table starts arguing about one Greek city versus another and asks your view. What do you do?
opcoes: Pick the city you liked more and say why
Repeat a joke you heard about one of them
Say εγώ δεν λέω τίποτα, smile, and ask them what they think
Change the subject to politics
perguntas.explica: The argument predates you and everyone there has standing in it that you do not. Being asked is hospitality; it carries no requirement to answer.

perguntas.pergunta: Which joke reliably works in a visitor's mouth?
opcoes: A joke about the neighbouring country
A joke about a Greek region
The joke about yourself — your Greek, your appetite, your reading of the alphabet
A joke about religion
perguntas.explica: Self-deprecation is the one register that travels intact. Reading ΡΟΔΟΣ aloud as Podos and admitting it gets a laugh because everyone has watched somebody do it.
